map.输入台风中心最低海平面气压，用 Atkinson-Holliday 经验公式估算: Enter the minimum central sea-level pressure of a typhoon and use the Atkinson-Holliday empirical formula to estimate the near-center maximum wind speed and rate the intensity.
map.节 = 0.5144 m/s。气压越低，最大风速越强。: 1 knot = 0.5144 m/s. The lower the air pressure, the stronger the maximum wind.
map.由近中心最大风速定台风等级（我国 12 级起）。: Rate the typhoon from the near-center maximum wind speed (force 12 and above in China).
map.区分台风/强台风/超强台风。: Distinguishes typhoon / severe typhoon / super typhoon.
map.：近中心最大风速 Vms=40 m/s → 落在 32.7–41.4 → 13: : near-center maximum wind Vms = 40 m/s → falls in 32.7–41.4 → force 13 (typhoon); Vms = 55 m/s → ≥51.0 → force 16 (super typhoon).
map.：12 级(≥32.7)黄色、14 级(≥41.5)橙色、16 级(≥51.0): : force 12 (≥32.7) yellow, force 14 (≥41.5) orange, force 16 (≥51.0) red — red for a super typhoon is the highest level and calls for full-scale defense.
map.我国台风几级算台风？: At What Force Does a Storm Count as a Typhoon in China?
map.底层近中心最大风力 ≥12 级（≥32.7 m/s）称台风；热带风暴 8–9 级: At the basic level a near-center maximum wind of force ≥12 (≥32.7 m/s) is called a typhoon; tropical storms are force 8–9 and severe tropical storms force 10–11.
map.用飞机穿心或浮标/雷达反演，地面站常被眼墙破坏，定强以最大风速为准。: Aircraft reconnaissance or buoy/radar retrieval is used, since surface stations are often destroyed by the eyewall; intensity rating is based on the maximum wind speed.
